name: University of the West of England (UWE)
description: The University of the West of England, Bristol (UWE Bristol) is a public research university, located in and around Bristol, England, which received university status in 1992. In common with the University of Bristol and University of Bath it can trace its origins to the Merchant Venturers' Technical College, founded as a school in 1595 by the Society of Merchant Venturers. UWE Bristol is made up of several campuses in Greater Bristol. UWE is ranked #21 in the UK by the Guardian and is ranked #2 in the UK for student satisfaction. Timestamps Updated

name: Falmouth University
description: Falmouth University, located in Cornwall, England, is a leading specialist institution for the creative industries, evolving from the Falmouth School of Arts (est. 1902) to university status in 2012. It offers industry-facing, hands-on courses across two campuses (Falmouth and Penryn) for over 7,900 students, focusing on employability in design, digital media, and performance. Timestamps Updated

name: University of Worcester (Undergraduate)
description: The University of Worcester is a close-knit and high-achieving community where students are supported to succeed at every level. The University has been ranked in the top 5 in the UK for Quality Education in all years of the Times Higher Education’s University Impact Rankings, which assess how universities globally are meeting the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals. The University has also been ranked in the top 5 in the UK for Gender Equality in all years of the rankings. Worcester has been shortlisted three times as the Times Higher Education’s University of the Year – in 2016, 2019 and 2020 - and twice for University of the Year in the UK Social Mobility Awards – in 2019 and 2020.The University scores consistently above our benchmark and the average in the National Student Survey. In 2021, Worcester Students’ Union was ranked among the top 10 unions at mainstream universities across the UK in the independent survey. Timestamps Updated

name: Kwantlen Polytechnic University
description: KPU is Canada's only polytechnic university. We focus on hands-on skills, in addition to traditional academics. Your education will go beyond books, with experiential learning opportunities like group projects, presentations, guest speakers, and more. Many of our programs include work experience terms, practicums, or cooperative education options. International learning opportunities all over the world through field schools, exchanges, study abroad opportunities, and more. Timestamps Updated

name: University of Worcester (Postgraduate)
description: The University of Worcester is a close-knit and high-achieving community where students are supported to succeed at every level. The University has been ranked in the top 5 in the UK for Quality Education in all years of the Times Higher Education’s University Impact Rankings, which assess how universities globally are meeting the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals. The University has also been ranked in the top 5 in the UK for Gender Equality in all years of the rankings.      Worcester has been shortlisted three times as the Times Higher Education’s University of the Year – in 2016, 2019 and 2020 - and twice for University of the Year in the UK Social Mobility Awards – in 2019 and 2020.The University scores consistently above our benchmark and the average in the National Student Survey. In 2021, Worcester Students’ Union was ranked among the top 10 unions at mainstream universities across the UK in the independent survey. Timestamps Updated

name: Marshall University
description: As one of West Virginia’s oldest public institutions, Marshall University has been dedicated to quality education with proven student success since 1837. Our vision is focused on providing a world-class education for students from across the country and around the globe.Ranked #299 U.S. News & World Report – Best National Rankings 2023 Timestamps Updated

name: Mercy University
description: Since 1950 we've been on a mission to reimagine higher education. Reshaping it around the dynamic needs of our students. We believe education is not just about classrooms and text books; it's about nurturing passions, fostering innovation and embracing the spirit of relentless curiosity. At Mercy University, we have been helping to empower generations of learners to break new ground, achieve forward momentum and create lasting impact that ripples beyond themselves, to their families and communities.

name: SRH Universities (India)
description: Modern campuses in Berlin, Heidelberg, Hamburg, Dresden, Leipzig, Cologne, Stuttgart, Hamm, Münster and Fürth. With over 16.000 students and a high graduate employability rate, the SRH Universities are a top provider of high-quality, state-accredited Bachelor's, Master’s and MBAs in Europe, delivered through both English and German medium. Study and research with us on real-life projects with practical partners from the fields of business, culture, politics and society. Work collaboratively with students from different disciplines. Gain access to our network of over 3,500 companies through internships and through the early integration of real work projects into your curriculum. Students can also benefit from free German language courses and career support. Coached and inspired by the best, you will set out on your individual path to a successful career. We can proudly state that 97 % of our alumni find employment within one year after graduation. Programmes in AI, Applied Mechatronic Systems, Architecture,  Blockchain, Business, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Film & Motion Design, Hospitality Management, Marketing,  Illustration, IT, Management, Music, Photography, Psychology, Cyber Security, UX Design, Web Development and many more. Timestamps Updated

name: Luiss University - Libera Università Internazionale degli Studi Sociali Guido Carli
description: The Libera Università Internazionale degli Studi Sociali "Guido Carli" founded by a group of entrepreneurs led by Umberto Agnelli, brother of Gianni Agnelli. It provides undergraduate and post-graduate education, in addition to a range of Double Degree programs, in the fields of finance, business, management, law and political science. It is located near the historical center of the city, between the neighborhoods of Parioli and Trieste.Luis is ranked #261 in the world and #11 in Italy by QS. Timestamps Updated

name: Glion
description: Since 1962, Glion Institute of Higher Education has set the highest standards for academic quality and hospitality excellence. It ranks among the world’s top institutions for hospitality and leisure management, and in the Top 2 globally for employer reputation. With campuses in Switzerland and London, Glion delivers a premium, personalized education combining practical skills with academic rigor. Timestamps Updated

name: Westminster International University in Tashkent
description: (WIUT) is the first international university in Uzbekistan and first in Central Asia to offer Western education, with United Kingdom (UK) qualifications. WIUT was established in 2002 in partnership between the "UMID" Presidential Foundation, the Ministry of Higher and Secondary Specialized Education of Uzbekistan, and the University of Westminster in London (UoW). Timestamps Updated

name: UCL Centre for Languages & International Education
description: UCL is amongst the best universities in the world. Academic excellence and disruptive thinking have been the status quo since 1826. UCL students are directly involved in research, equipping them for the future and inspiring a lifelong curiosity. We teach our students how to think, not what to think. Amongst the very best in the world8th in the world (QS World University Rankings 2022)2nd in UK for research power (REF 2021)1st in England to welcome students of any religion or social background.1st in England to welcome women to university education.1st in England to teach English, German, Chemistry, Engineering.A brave and progressive approach that has continued to this day.1st in England to have a fully open access university press. Timestamps Updated

name: University Bridge
description: UBridge is the marriage of the nation’s premier two-year colleges with an educational firm committed to enriching students’ lives through successful college transfers. The unique, tailored academic experience offers guaranteed admissions to top universities in the United States. UBridge’s guaranteed admissions offers stem from articulation agreements between their two-year colleges and a number of elite four-year colleges. The University Bridge program is an all-inclusive academic experience tailored to international students looking to study in the U.S. Timestamps Updated

name: CESI School of Engineering
description: CESI gives each engineering student the opportunity to build a tailor-made career path. With 25 campuses around France, CESI supports engineering students through a customizable five-year education leading to the Master’s-level Engineering Degree accredited by the French state. Engineers must be multi-talented, possess both scientific and technical knowledge, and have a good understanding of the mechanisms of management and administration. CESI offers  a multi-cultural environment where French and international students are trained to leave a positive impact on our globalized world. Timestamps

name: MPW
cityHints: close proximity to prestigious university campuses
description: Founded in London in 1973 by three Cambridge University graduates, the MPW Group is one of the best known and well respected independent college brands in the UK. It comprises three fifth- and sixth-form colleges in London, Birmingham and Cambridge, providing highly attractive and modern learning environments located in close proximity to prestigious university campuses. MPW has a highly consistent record of exam results over many years and across all three colleges. A Level results for 2019 show this continuing success:36% of exams taken at MPW resulted in grade A*/A (against the national average of 26%). Students live in a range of safe and secure high-quality student accommodation, including fully-supervised student residence, homestay accommodation, or if they are older and more independent, in apartments.

name: On Campus Ireland
description: OnCampus Ireland offers high-quality university preparation programmes for international students. Offering guaranteed conditional progression, on successful completion of the OnCampus programme, students progress to degree study at a range of Irish and European partner institutions. Timestamps Updated

name: Wycombe Abbey International School, Bangkok
description: Founded in 1896 by Dame Frances Dove, the original school in Buckinghamshire, UK, set a new standard for academic rigour and character development. Today, Wycombe Abbey International School Bangkok continues that vision, ensuring that the same spirit of excellence thrives in the heart of Southeast Asia. Wycombe Abbey is a globally respected name with a heritage rooted in exceptional academic results and character education. Wycombe Abbey has been at the forefront of academic achievement, with 28% of graduates annually securing places at Oxford and Cambridge during the last 10 years. Timestamps Updated

name: Peking University HSBC Business School
description: Peking University HSBC Business School (PHBS) is a Graduate Business School of Peking University, one of the best universities in China and worldwide. Peking University is ranked 14th in the world by QS world university ranking 2026 and 4th in the world for Business and Economics by THE Subject ranking 2025. The School is among the 1% of the business school worldwide to hold the “Triple Crown” accreditation from AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS, attesting to its commitment to outstanding business education. As the most internationalized business school in China, the school currently offer Masters and PhD in Management, Finance, and Economics in English to international students.

name: Wycombe Abbey International School, Hong kong
description: Wycombe Abbey School Hong Kong (WASHK), a sister school of the UK’s renowned Wycombe Abbey, is a leading British international school for students aged 5 to 18 (Year 1 to Year 13). Established in 2019, the school combines Wycombe Abbey’s 130 years of British academic excellence with innovative learning. WASHK is committed to strengthening core disciplines, including STEM subjects, English, and Mandarin proficiency, while fostering future-ready skills through dynamic modules in entrepreneurship, leadership, and digital literacy. The school prides itself on cultivating self-motivated learners driven by intellectual curiosity and intrinsic passion, empowering them to excel academically and develop as future-ready leaders.

name: Wycombe Abbey International School
description: The Wycombe Abbey International Changzhou campus covers an area of 25 acres and has state-of-the-art facilities with three distinctive round buildings housing the sports centre and arts and drama departments. The campus has a fully equipped theatre, 400-metre outdoor running track, inflatable air dome sports stadium, indoor basketball courts, multiple floodlit tennis courts, indoor sports fields, a purpose-built water sports centre and swimming pools and as it is situated by a lake, it has world-class rowing facilities. For music, there are smaller performance, rehearsal and ensemble rooms, practice rooms, music teaching classrooms, and a jam room complete with the latest technology for all electronic instruments. Pupils have endless opportunities to participate and perform in sport, music and drama. Timestamps Updated

name: ILAC International Language Academy of Canada
description: ILAC is one of the most awarded English language schools in the world, with campuses in Toronto and Vancouver. Every year, ILAC is recognized for its commitment to excellence in English training and customer service. ILAC welcomes students from more than 75 countries, making it one of the world’s most diverse schools to learn English. ILAC schools are accredited by those bodies designated to oversee schools in the education industry in Canada. Our accreditation by recognized industry organizations helps protect students’ rights. Timestamps Updated

name: St. James Catholic Middle School
description: Amerigo Los Angeles Middle School sets students up for success at a rigorous American high school and beyond. Students have access to a curriculum specially designed to meet the specific needs of each individual student. They also have the chance to begin building their leadership skills outside of the classroom, through a wide array of extracurricular clubs, activities and competitive sports teams. Timestamps Updated

name: TEDI - London
description: Welcome to TEDI-London. We believe it’s time to rethink engineering education. Not just to improve engineers’ futures, but to make life better for everyone. When we opened, we began training the engineers of the future; people with the ingenuity and enterprise to use engineering to leave the world a better, fairer place. We’re delighted to now partner with Kaplan International Pathways to bring TEDI-London to a global student audience. Timestamps Updated
